description: This source file provides utilities for parsing XLSX files using pandas and openpyxl, generating safe pandas code prompts with Gemini AI, validating code safety, executing generated code in a controlled environment against XLSX data, and utility functions for relevance-based column selection. It enables programmatic analysis and querying of Excel spreadsheets with AI assistance.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] extract_xlsx_schema_from_bytes(content: bytes)
methods.description: Parses XLSX content bytes to extract schema information including sheet names, headers, and number of data rows.

methods.name: str generate_pandas_code_with_gemini(user_query: str, top_columns: List[str], schema: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Constructs and sends a prompt to Gemini AI to generate safe pandas code based on user query, relevant columns, and XLSX schema.

methods.name: str execute_safe_pandas_code_on_xlsx(code: str, xlsx_bytes: bytes)
methods.description: Validates, executes, and securely runs user-generated pandas code against XLSX data, returning a formatted result.

methods.name: List[str] get_top_k_relevant_columns_for_query(user_query: str, header_store: Dict[str, Any], k: int = 5)
methods.description: Selects the most relevant columns from stored headers based on a user query using lexical overlap scoring.

methods.name: str _build_gemini_pandas_prompt(user_query: str, top_columns: List[str], schema: Dict[str, Any])
List[str] _pick_top_k_columns(query: str, columns: List[str], k: int = 5)
